preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string `s` contains only lowercase alphabetic characters.

postconditions.description: The output string has the same length as the input string `s`.

postconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string contains only lowercase alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == s[i]) if (s[i] == 'c' or s[i] == 'o' or s[i] == 'd' or s[i] == 'e') else True for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: If the original character is 'c', 'o', 'd', or 'e', the output character remains unchanged.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') + 9) % 26) + ord('a'))) if (s[i] not in 'aeiouy' and s[i] not in 'codoe') else True for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: For consonants (excluding 'c', 'o', 'd', 'e'), move forward 9 places in the alphabet, wrapping around from 'z' to 'a'.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') - 5) % 26) + ord('a'))) if (s[i] in 'aeiou' and s[i] != 'y') else True for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: For vowels (excluding 'y'), move back 5 places in the alphabet, wrapping around from 'a' to 'z'.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') - 1) % 26) + ord('a'))) if (s[i] == 'c') else True for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: If the original character is 'c', move it back 1 place (exception rule).

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') - 3) % 26) + ord('a'))) if (s[i] == 'd') else True for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: If the original character is 'd', move it back 3 places (exception rule).

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == chr(((ord(s[i]) - ord('a') - 4) % 26) + ord('a'))) if (s[i] == 'e') else True for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: If the original character is 'e', move it back 4 places (exception rule).

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == s[i]) if (return_value[i] in 'codoe') else True for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: If a moved letter becomes 'c', 'o', 'd', or 'e', revert it back to its original value.
